newsitem.title: USA: National Energy production rises at well.
newsitem.headline: National Energy production rises at well.

text.p: National Energy Group Inc said its Schwing #2 well at the East Bayou Sorrel Field in Iberville Parish, Louisiana, was placed on production at 2,464 barrels of oil equivalent per day -- after initially testing at a combined rate of 1,854 barrels of equivalent per day.
National Energy said in a statement on Monday that the well is producing from a dual completion in the Cib. hazz 2 sand and the Marg. howeii 1, 2, and 3 sands.
The East Bayou Sorrel Field is currently producing 3,331 barrels of oil and 3.8 million cubic feet of natural gas per day from its two wells.
National Energy holds a 60 percent working interest in the field, while the company's partners include Fortune Petroleum Corp, Pease Oil and Gas Co and Liberty Mutual Insurance.
